pattern: goal registry concurrent writes can drop freshly created goals when runtime sync or multiple creators write stale snapshots
symptoms: mainline-goal returns a new goal object but the goal is missing from goal_registry.json afterwards
parallel goal creation leaves only the last created goal persisted
runtime sync can overwrite newly created goals if it saves an older in-memory snapshot
fix: merge unseen goals from the current registry before save_goals writes
serialize goal creation writes instead of submitting multiple state mutations in parallel
restart long-running daemon processes after changing goal persistence logic
validation: sequential mainline-goal creation persists all expected goal_ids in factory/goals/goal_registry.json
